title: Page 4
content_zh:
“当然，赵先生您的请求我们“一生一世”一定会做到。”白薇秀眼底闪过一丝不满，实在是因为他高傲的口气颇惹人厌。

“我不信人，只信白纸黑字。”

这话更让白薇秀不爽，不过她不会拿最爱的钱开玩笑，只能陪着笑。“赵先生的意思是？”

“我要求签署保密条款，若违约的话，“一生一世”必须支付庞大违约金。”赵霖没有忽略她眼底一闪而过的不满，他觉得好笑。看来这位婚顾师，个性不像表现出来的那般柔和，只是在职场上压抑了自己。

这发现挺好玩的，他相信在接下来枯燥无味的筹办婚礼过程中，会因为她而多了几分乐趣。

第2章(1)

白薇秀最近压力很大，大到晚上睡不好也睡得少，嘴里也因为火气太大破洞了，每天必须随身携带广×苜药粉。

原因就出在收了赵霖跟颜芳菲那对贵客开始，首先，举办婚礼的时间很紧迫，他们必须在最短的时间内达成准新人的要求，颜芳菲还算好讲话，而且非常配合，反倒是那个不常露面的赵霖，常常透过颜芳菲的口传达他的挑剔，或是亲自打电话来指正，害她现在看到熟悉的手机号码，在按下接听之前，手都会不自觉的抖个两下。

这算是抑郁症的前兆吗？不过，看在钱的分上、看在钱的分上、看在钱的分上……她每次都只能这么自我勉励跟催眠。

赵霖的确是个非常肯花钱的准新郎，他没有设下婚礼预算的上限，只吩咐颜芳菲想要怎么样的婚礼，照她的意思办就对了。

对此，本来白薇秀以为只要把颜芳菲照顾得服服贴贴就行了，没想到赵霖不罗唆、花钱不手软，但真的很挑剔。

坦白说，这对新人是她见过最奇怪的组合。

除了第一次，之后的婚纱挑选、婚礼地点选择、婚礼内容细目等项协调，都只有颜芳菲出面，她当然解释过是因为他很忙，抽不出时间。

白薇秀笑笑，表面上不以为意，心里头却忍不住嘀咕，她也曾遇过工作很忙的新郎，但结婚是两个人的事，他怎么可以置身事外到这等地步？

她不这么想还好，才刚有这样的念头，麻烦事就接踵而来，本以为赵霖应该是三不管新郎，没想到她根本就是大错特错！

举例来说，在婚纱跟挑选新娘造型师方面，颜芳菲作主，赵霖不管，她喜欢就好，就算她挑了件刚在国外成名红回台湾的新锐设计师的婚纱礼服，价值不菲，他也没吭一声，还有喜宴上三套手工订制礼服，总价超过百万，他也没有意见。

可对于他所在意的事……白薇秀觉得他在意的都是些挺奇怪的事。

哪个婚礼上不用花朵装饰？花代表浪漫，尤其是玫瑰，颜芳菲喜欢粉玫瑰，她建议采用大量的粉玫瑰加上气球跟缎带，摆设在红毯周围，重点是，花艺会设计得很时尚典雅，偏偏赵霖却反对。

“我不喜欢花，尤其是玫瑰，气球跟缎带也太幼稚！”

白薇秀记得他是透过电话这么命令的。很好，没有花跟气球、缎带的婚礼，她得想出其它应变的方法，那花瓣总可以吧？再派几个可爱天真的小天使，在新郎、新娘前方撒玫瑰花瓣……

“无聊。”

赵霖在电话彼端冷冷的一句，害白薇秀气得差点砸了电话，但很快的她想到了钱，为了“一生一世”在淡季的生存，她吞下了委屈，不让真实的个性爆出来。

她小心翼翼的说：“要不然搭乘梦幻马车……”

这回他连话都懒得说了，直接不屑的哼了一声。

白薇秀这下不想砸电话了，这么做哪足以发泄她的不满，她想要喷火，把眼前的那面墙给烧了。

这样不行，幼稚；那个不要，无聊；他到底想怎样？！

“要不然我安排几个穿黑西装打领带戴墨镜的男人，手中各扛一把AK47帮你们的婚礼开场如何？”

白薇秀翻翻白眼，她真想豁出去直接对着他吼，喔，不，她是真的那么说了，对着话筒，她真的说了！

她错愕的瞪着电话，头皮发麻，甚至可以感觉到从话筒那一端传来的冷意，过了好一会儿，她才稍微平复下来，用力抹去额头瞬间冒出的冷汗，陪着干笑。

“抱歉，我刚刚失控了，您大人有大量，忘记我刚刚说的话吧。啊，我刚好有其它的电话进来，对不起，再联络再讨论。”

白薇秀自导自演，赶紧挂掉电话先。

妈啊，她连小腿都在打颤，这下她该怎么收尾才好？

嗯，她说了什么？

要不然我安排几个穿黑西装打领带戴墨镜的男人，手中各扛一把AK47帮你们的婚礼开场如何？

要不是她电话挂得太快，错愕之后，他或许会说这是个不错的建议，真亏她想得出来。

好吧，他承认，自己并不想成为那么难搞的客人，关于婚礼细节，他交给颜芳菲全权处理，他只在乎婚礼必须如期举行，而且要极为盛大，办得像真的一样，他会在众多宾客前亲吻颜芳菲，和她交换戒指跟爱的誓言。

这一切，他亲爱的继母都会在场观礼，她肯定是脸上带着笑，心里却恨到猛咬牙，她想利用女人控制他的梦想正式破灭。

所以对他而言，婚礼要怎么进行，真的无所谓，只是颜芳菲的经纪人会定期传来她近来跟婚礼顾问公司洽谈的内容，这样也好方便公司这边拨款给她。

关于婚纱跟喜宴礼服就要花掉他两百多万，赵霖连眉头也没皱一下，倒是对于进场方式非常有意见，还有，之前拍婚纱照时，他不想当白痴被婚纱公司摆布一整天，直接一句不用拍，丝毫不理会新娘子的心情，当时白薇秀就被他的决定给震撼到嘴巴差点阖不起来。

许是因为他对婚礼没有什么感觉，在婚礼上搞浪漫他觉得没有必要，才会拨了电话，然后他惹恼了那个双面人性格、身材却棒到极点的婚顾师。

喔，他不得不承认，他对她的印象还真是深刻，瞧他竟然记得她的名字，当然更记得她那丰满的胸部。

若说她是波霸，好像还不至于，可她丰满的胸围跟纤细的柳腰形成美丽的S弧度，还有那双长腿，如果夹在男人的腰上……他离题了，好像。

没想到白薇秀会真的把心里头所想的话给直接吼出来，看来他真的惹毛了她，想必她现在应该恐惧不已，就怕把他这个付钱的大爷给惹毛了。

一想到她有可能像小兔子一样发抖，赵霖的嘴角不自觉的上扬。瞧他，好形象顾及太久，差点都忘了自己有仇必报、心机深沉到有些变态的本性。

逗弄白薇秀，让他此时心情很愉悦，他应该马上再打电话给她，说他很欣赏她的点子，希望她在婚礼上照办，呵呵，不知道那只双面人小兔子会有什么反应？

说他很坏吗？还好吧，他只是坏得很恰当而已。

白薇秀在许安安离开公司前，紧抓着他的手臂摇啊摇，无赖的要求道：“安安，带我去喝酒，我要喝酒，我压力太大了……”

现在是晚上七点，许安安也不是那么不近人情，尤其最近大家压力真的都很大，但最严重的莫过于眼前这位钱嫂，她想赚钱，但也不可能砸了自己婚顾师的头衔。

她绝对会办出一场轰轰烈烈，让参加的宾客都难忘的世纪婚礼，要知道遇到这种预算无上限的准新人客户，是很难得的，就算再难搞也得搞下去。
content_en:
"Of course, Mr. Zhao, we will definitely fulfill your request "for the rest of my life."" Bai Weixiu's eyes flashed with dissatisfaction, because his arrogant tone was quite annoying.

"I don't believe in people, I only believe in black and white words."

These words made Bai Weixiu even more unhappy, but she would not joke about her favorite money, she could only laugh along with him."What does Mr. Zhao mean?"

"I asked to sign a confidentiality clause. If I break the contract, I will have to pay a huge penalty for my whole life." Zhao Lin did not ignore the flash of dissatisfaction in her eyes. He found it funny.It seems that this wedding counselor's personality is not as gentle as shown, but he just suppresses himself in the workplace.

This discovery was quite fun, and he believed that the boring process of planning the wedding would be a little more fun because of her.

Chapter 2(1)

Bai Weixiu has been under a lot of pressure recently, so much so that she can't sleep well at night and doesn't get enough sleep. She also has holes in her mouth because of the anger, and she has to carry Cantonese alfalfa powder with her every day.

The reason lies in the reception of the distinguished guests Zhao Lin and Yan Fangfei. First of all, the time for the wedding is very tight. They must meet the requirements of the newlyweds in the shortest possible time. Yan Fangfei is relatively easy to talk to and very cooperative. On the contrary, Zhao Lin, who does not often show up, often conveys his pickiness through Yan Fangfei's mouth, or calls to correct him in person. Now that she sees a familiar mobile phone number, her hands will shake twice unconsciously before pressing the button to answer.

Is this a sign of depression?However, for the sake of money, for the sake of money, for the sake of money...she can only encourage and hypnotize herself like this every time.

Zhao Lin is indeed a groom-to-be who is very willing to spend money. He did not set an upper limit for the wedding budget. He only told Yan Fangfei to do what she wanted for the wedding.

In this regard, Bai Weixiu originally thought that it would be enough to take care of Yan Fangfei obediently, but she did not expect that Zhao Lin would not be instigative or merciless in spending money, but he was really picky.

Frankly, this couple was the strangest pair she had ever seen.

Except for the first time, only Yan Fangfei came forward for the subsequent coordination of wedding dress selection, wedding location selection, wedding content details, etc. Of course she explained that it was because he was very busy and couldn't spare the time.

Bai Weixiu smiled and didn't care on the surface, but she couldn't help but murmur in her heart. She had also met a groom who was very busy at work, but marriage was a matter between two people. How could he stay out of it to such an extent?

It's okay that she didn't think so. As soon as she had such an idea, troubles came one after another. She thought that Zhao Lin should be a neglectful groom, but she didn't expect that she was totally wrong!

For example, when it comes to the wedding dress and the selection of the bridal stylist, Yan Fangfei makes the decision, Zhao Lin doesn't care, as long as she likes it. Even if she chooses a wedding dress from a cutting-edge designer who has just become famous abroad and returned to Taiwan, and it is very valuable, he does not say a word. There are also three handmade custom-made dresses for the wedding banquet, with a total price of more than one million, he has no objection.

But as for the things he cared about... Bai Weixiu felt that the things he cared about were quite strange.

What wedding doesn’t use flowers?Flowers represent romance, especially roses. Yan Fangfei likes pink roses. She suggested using a large number of pink roses, balloons and ribbons, and placing them around the red carpet. The point is, the floral arrangement will be designed to be fashionable and elegant, but Zhao Lin was opposed to it.

"I don't like flowers, especially roses. Balloons and ribbons are too childish!"

Bai Weixiu remembered that he gave the order over the phone.Very good. For a wedding without flowers, balloons, and ribbons, she had to come up with other ways to adapt to the situation. Petals would do the trick, right?Then send a few cute and innocent little angels to scatter rose petals in front of the bride and groom...

"Boring."

Zhao Lin's cold words on the other end of the phone made Bai Weixiu so angry that she almost smashed the phone, but she soon thought of money. In order to survive in the off-season "for the rest of her life", she swallowed her grievances and prevented her true personality from being revealed.

She said cautiously: "How about taking a ride on the dream carriage..."

This time he didn't even bother to say anything, and just snorted disdainfully.

Bai Weixiu didn't want to smash the phone now. Doing so would not be enough to vent her dissatisfaction. She wanted to spit fire and burn the wall in front of her.

This won't work, it's childish; that won't work, it's boring; what on earth does he want?!

"How about I arrange for a few men in black suits, ties and sunglasses, each carrying an AK47, to kick off your wedding?"

Bai Weixiu rolled her eyes. She really wanted to risk her life and yell at him directly. Oh, no, she really said that. She really said it into the microphone!

She stared at the phone in shock, her scalp was numb, and she could even feel the coldness coming from the other end of the phone. After a while, she calmed down a little, wiped the cold sweat that suddenly appeared on her forehead, and laughed.

"I'm sorry, I just lost control. You, sir, have a lot of questions. Please forget what I just said. Ah, I just had other calls coming in. I'm sorry. I'll contact you again to discuss it later."

Bai Weixiu directed and acted, so she quickly hung up the phone.

Oh my god, even her calves are trembling. How should she end it now?

Well, what did she say?

How about I arrange for a few men in black suits, ties and sunglasses, each carrying an AK47, to kick off your wedding?

If she hadn't hung up the phone so quickly, after being stunned, he might have said that this was a good suggestion. It's a shame she thought of it.

Well, he admitted that he didn't want to be such a difficult guest. Regarding the wedding details, he left it to Yan Fangfei to handle all the details. He only cared that the wedding must be held as scheduled, and it must be extremely grand and real. He would kiss Yan Fangfei in front of many guests and exchange rings and vows of love with her.

His dear stepmother would be there to watch all this. She must have a smile on her face, but she was gritting her teeth in hatred. Her dream of using women to control him was officially shattered.

So to him, it really didn't matter how the wedding was going to be carried out, except that Yan Fangfei's agent would regularly send her the contents of her recent negotiations with the wedding consulting company, so that it would be easier for the company to allocate funds to her.

As for the wedding dress and the wedding dress, which cost him more than two million yuan, Zhao Lin didn't even frown, but he had a lot of opinions on the way to enter. Also, when taking wedding photos before, he didn't want to be an idiot and be manipulated by the wedding dress company all day long, so he just didn't take pictures and paid no attention to the bride's mood. At that time, Bai Weixiu was so shocked by his decision that she almost couldn't close her mouth.

Maybe it was because he didn't feel much about the wedding and he didn't think it was necessary to be romantic at the wedding, so he dialed the number, and then he annoyed the wedding consultant who had a two-faced personality and an extremely good figure.

Oh, he had to admit, he was really impressed by her. Look, he actually remembered her name, and of course he remembered her plump breasts.

If she is a busty woman, it doesn't seem to be enough, but her plump bust and slender waist form a beautiful S-curve, and her long legs, if clamped on a man's waist... He digressed, it seems.

She didn't expect that Bai Weixiu would actually yell out what was on her mind. It seemed that he had really pissed her off. She must be terrified now, fearing that she might piss off the man who paid him.

When he thought that she might tremble like a little rabbit, the corners of Zhao Lin's mouth rose unconsciously.Look at him, he has been thinking about his good image for so long that he almost forgot about his perverted and scheming nature.

Teasing Bai Weixiu made him feel very happy at the moment. He should call her right away and say that he appreciates her idea and hopes she will do it at the wedding. Haha, I wonder how that little two-faced rabbit will react?

Do you say he is bad?It's okay, he's just appropriately bad.

Before Xu Anan left the company, Bai Weixiu grabbed Xu Anan's arm and shook him. She demanded roguely: "An'an, take me to drink. I want to drink. I'm too stressed..."

It's seven o'clock in the evening, and Xu An'an is not that unkind, especially since everyone has been under a lot of pressure recently, but the most serious one is Mrs. Qian in front of her. She wants to make money, but she can't ruin her title as a wedding consultant.

She will definitely organize a spectacular wedding of the century that will be unforgettable for all the guests who attend. You must know that it is rare to meet such a prospective newlywed client with an unlimited budget. No matter how difficult it is, she must continue to do it.
